_comment: Copy to .ttf/scope.json and edit. This declares the ONLY systems you authorize the loop (and your AI pair) to test. Testing anything outside this is out of scope.
statement: I own or am actively developing the targets below and authorize defensive self-assessment against them.

in_scope.data: test accounts and seeded/fixture data only

hosts: anything I do not own or control
actions: attacking systems I do not own
using real user data, real credentials, secrets or tokens
any destructive action (delete/overwrite of real data)

rules: Exploit = controlled proof on my own instance using test data; redact all evidence.
If an action would fall outside this scope, stop and reconsider instead of proceeding.
